word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Brainstorm Community Signals

conceptHeader.description: An endorsement or veto signal issued by an author for a target pubkey within the context of a Brainstorm Community (referenced by `a` tag — either a NIP-72 kind 34550 or a native kind 39999 community-record). All such signals share a single global Endorsements DList. Mirror relays consume these signals via the GR Community scoring system to compute community membership. SKELETON — schema details may evolve before v1.1.0 is activated. See COMMUNITY_ENDORSEMENTS_DLIST.md for the canonical spec.
